_about: Every tunable in Wizard Bullet Hell. Keys starting with _ are notes. Spell values for evolved tiers use _t2 / _t3 suffixes.

global._castRate: Multiplies every spell cooldown and enemy attack interval.

orbits._about: Forest Wisps and Mirror Ward share evenly spaced rings around the wizard, inner ring first to whichever was learned first. radius = inner ring, spacing = gap between rings, in world units.

music._about: Zone music. volume multiplies audio.volume and the player's Settings volume; fade = crossfade seconds on zone changes and when a run starts or ends.
music._crush: Bitcrusher on the music only: 0 = clean, 1 = very chunky (16 -> 4 bits, sample rate down to 1/16). Try 0.3-0.6 for a retro feel.
music._crushMix: How much crushed sound to blend in (0 = none, 1 = all).

tracks._about: File name in Assets/Resources/Music without the extension; empty = none. Zones without a track play their chiptune takes; boss fights without one use boss.any, then the zone track.
tracks.title: music_title_world_of_magic

audio._lowHealthAt: Health fraction below which the low-health warning plays (once per drop below it).

sfx._about: Volume of each individual sound (1 = default, 0 = off), on top of audio.volume and the Settings volume. Grouped by what plays it.

settings._about: Defaults for the player's Settings screen. Once a player changes an option, their choice is kept on the phone.

ui._artStylePicker: Show the art style picker on the title screen. Off = Dusk only (store builds).
ui._debugToggle: Show the Debug button on the title and pause screens in release builds (always shown in development builds).
ui._tunerButton: Show the Tuner row (Connect to the Mac's tuner) in Settings. Turn off for App Store builds.

hud._fontScale: Text size multiplier for the pixel font (Dusk and CRT); VT323 draws small for its point size.

effectCounters._about: The combo name with an x### tally under it, over combos and bug bursts. size = text scale (damage numbers are 0.05), nameSize = name size relative to the tally, offset = units above the trigger spot, life in seconds, rise in units/s.

fx._about: Particle sparks, Dusk art style only. count = particles per effect, speed in units/s, size in world units (Dusk rounds to whole pixels), life in seconds.

drops._extra: Bonus drops rolled on every kill. tier: Any, Chaff, Medium or Boss. Add as many as you like.

spawning._chaff: Chaff per second in a zone = (chaffBase + seconds in zone*chaffPerSecond) * (1 + chaffPerThreat*swarms in zone) + run.zoneRateStep*zones cleared, capped at chaffMax.

run._bosses: Bosses per run. Each one (spawning.bossEvery apart) moves the run to a new zone; killing the last one wins. 0 = endless.
run._startTomeChoices: How many starting tomes are offered at the start of a run.
run._zoneShiftDelay: Seconds between a boss dying and the zone changing (time to grab the loot).
run._favoredWeight: How much more often a zone's home medium enemies show up.
run._zoneRampSeconds: A new zone starts empty; spawning ramps from 0 to full over this many seconds (second zone), times zoneRampFactor for each zone after that. zoneFirstMedium is the delay before the first medium enemy, scaled the same way.
run._zoneRateStep: Extra chaff per second for each zone already cleared; every zone otherwise reuses the first zone's curve from its own start.

meta._about: Gold and the Grimoire. Gold per run = kills + bosses + minutes survived (+ goldWin on a win), kept even if you die. Arcane Missile, Fireball and Frost Nova tomes are free; the rest cost tomeCost. Evolution II needs its feat (beat featBossesT2 bosses with the spell in your build), III needs its signature feat (see feats).

feats._about: Tier III signature feats: done within one run while the spell is at tier II+. kind: count (adds up), max (best single moment), win (adds up, completes only on a win). {goal} in text shows the goal. Spells without an entry keep the old feat (win a run with the spell at tier II+).

ArcaneMissile.text: Land {goal} Arcane Missile hits in one run

Fireball.text: Hit {goal} foes with a single Fireball explosion

ChainLightning.text: Chain through {goal} foes in one cast

Rejuvenate.text: Spend {goal}s below 25% health and win the run

Overgrowth.text: Kill {goal} foes while they're trapped in vines, in one run

Veil.text: Avoid {goal} killing blows in one run

TidalLance.text: Hit Wet foes {goal} times with Storm or Frost spells in one run

Enthrall.text: Charmed foes kill {goal} foes in one run

StoneSpikes.text: Absorb {goal} bullet damage with stone walls in one run

SpectralBlades.text: Hit {goal} foes with a single blade throw

Sunspots.text: Stay Sunlit for {goal}s in one run

Cyclone.text: Pass {goal} conditions between foes with a single whirlwind

Wisps.text: Trigger all {goal} wisp reactions in one run (burning, wet, chilled, infested, rooted foes)

CometTrail.text: Have {goal} foes burning from your trail at the same moment

Banish.text: Have {goal} foes banished at the same moment

telemetry._about: Run logs sent to the tuner (Runs page; files in tools/tuner/telemetry). enabled = record runs at all. enemyEvents = one line per enemy spawn and kill (the summary always has per-enemy totals). snapshotEvery = seconds of play between tick lines (health, level, enemies alive). flushEvery = real seconds between uploads during a run.

runes._startSockets: Rune sockets per spell at the start of a run; each boss kill adds socketsPerBoss. A spell with every socket filled can evolve.
runes._evolveRetain: Share of a spell's rune power kept when it evolves (0-1). Fractions of Split/Pierce/Echo become a chance per cast.

Haste._castSpeedPerRune: Each Haste rune adds this much cast speed (cooldown / (1 + this x runes)), so it doesn't compound.

Overload._about: Every Nth cast of the spell is overloaded: damage (or healing) x (1 + bonusPerRune x runes) until the next cast.

Siphon._about: Hits heal healPerRune x damage per rune, at most capPerRune HP a second per rune.

Ward._about: Each cast of the spell grants a ward that blocks one enemy bullet. Max wards = Ward runes across all spells; at most one new ward every cooldown seconds.

Soak._about: Hits make foes Wet for durationBase + durationPerRune x runes seconds (one wet gauge unit per hit).

Static._about: Each hit sparks to the nearest other foe within range for damagePerRune x runes of the hit, as a Storm hit (Conductive on Wet foes). At most one spark per spell every cooldown seconds.

Wither._about: Foes hit deal weakenPerRune x runes less damage (bullets, contact, hazards) and fire slowPerRune x runes slower, for duration seconds.

Midas._about: Foes this spell kills have chancePerRune x runes (up to maxChance) to drop gold (+bossBonus on bosses), added to the run's gold.

runes._weight: Relative chance to be offered. Under 5 shows as RARE.

FrostNova._shatterSpread_t3: Tier III: frostbite given to foes within shatterSpreadRadius_t3 when a foe shatters (status.shatterChainDepth caps the chain).

Wisps._bonusWispLife: Tier III: each kill adds a wisp to the inner ring for this many seconds, up to maxBonusWisps extra.
Wisps._huntEvery: Each wisp darts at a foe every huntEvery x cooldown seconds.
Wisps._huntDamage: A dart hits for damage x this.
Wisps._flareDamage: Dart into a burning foe: the wisp explodes for flareDamage (scaled by potency) in flareRadius, then re-forms after respawnTime.
Wisps._arcDamage: Dart into a wet foe: lightning arcs to up to arcTargets other wet foes for damage x arcDamage.
Wisps._frostbite: Dart into a chilled foe: adds this much frostbite.
Wisps._devourBelow: Dart into an infested non-boss foe at or below this fraction of max HP: it dies outright and its bugs burst.
Wisps._drainHeal: Dart into a rooted foe: heals this fraction of max HP.

Rejuvenate._damage: Fraction of max health healed per pulse.
Rejuvenate._reviveChargeTime_t3: Tier III: seconds to charge the revive (Haste runes shorten it).

Overgrowth._deathBloomScale_t3: Tier III: size of the vine patch a dying trapped foe sprouts, relative to the normal patch.
Overgrowth._thornDps_t2: Damage per second to trapped foes; foes bumping a trapped foe take this much per bump.

Veil._phasePerPotency: Extra phase time per Potency rune (0.05 = +5%). potencyPerRune still scales pass-through damage.

TidalLance._areaScale: Share of each Area rune that grows the spray (length and width).
TidalLance._pillarWet_t3: Tier III: seconds a water pillar keeps foes Wet.
TidalLance._coneAngle_t2: Half-angle of the spray cone in degrees.

Cyclone._passDamage: Reaction damage (x damage) for each condition a foe catches from the others in the whirlwind eye.
Cyclone._passDuration: Seconds a passed-on burn, chill, wet or infestation lasts.

Enthrall._maxThralls_t3: Tier III: most permanently charmed foes at once.

MirrorWard._shardLength: Each mirror shard is a curved bar along its ring: length along the ring and thickness, in world units (Area scales both).
MirrorWard._damage: Damage per reflected bolt. cooldown only sets spin speed (Haste spins faster).

StoneSpikes._wallHealth: Bullet damage a wall spike absorbs before it breaks (x potency; most bullets do 10). Bosses smash walls on contact.
StoneSpikes._wallTime_t2: Seconds an evolved spike stays up as a wall (blocks enemy bullets, holds foes back).
StoneSpikes._shardDamage_t3: Rockburst shard damage as a share of the spike damage.

SpectralBlades._damage: Damage each time a blade passes through a foe (out and back are separate passes).

CometTrail._damage: Per tick to foes standing in a flame patch.
CometTrail._spacing: You drop a patch each time you've moved this far (and the cooldown is up).
CometTrail._burnShare: Each tick also sets a burn of damage x burnShare per second for burnTime seconds.
CometTrail._burstDamage_t3: Phoenix Path: each patch bursts when it burns out for damage x this in burstRadius_t3.

Banish._damage: Banish deals no damage itself; this feeds status runes (Ember, Infest) and nothing else.
Banish._bossDaze: Bosses can't be banished; they can't shoot for this many seconds instead. Returning foes can't shoot for returnDaze.
Banish._exileRadius_t2: Exile banishes every foe this close to the target. Area runes grow it at areaScale of their normal rate.
Banish._oblivionLoss_t3: Oblivion: banished chaff never return (no bug burst); others return missing this share of max health.

Sunspots._damage: Share of max health healed per second while standing in a pool.
Sunspots._moveBuff: Sunlit bonuses at power 1 (Potency and Solar Flare raise the power); they last sunlitTime seconds after leaving a pool.
Sunspots._burnDamage_t2: Damage every 0.5s to foes inside a pool (tier II+).
